The note says "You've disappointed me so much; I'm never coming back," addressed to him, so finding it would look like she simply abandoned him. He copies her handwriting over and over, making draft after draft of that same short note — the sentence appearing seven times is those repeated attempts. But his imitation is obviously poor and doesn't match her real handwriting. Looking at the failed drafts, he sighs, "I know I'm in trouble" — the forgery is too unconvincing to work.
